name: Csörnyeföld (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Csörnyeföld (a red and green shield with a yellow lion and a bunch of grapes, within a green wreath) above a yellow scroll inscribed CSÖRNYEFÖLD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csörnyeföld arms with wreath and scroll
